# Anivora 0.1.43 — Audio-aware downloads and Android reliability

- Keep SUB/DUB downloads separate, preserve known language metadata, and retain existing downloads without inventing the audio of unknown legacy files.
- Respect per-download storage choices, support verified MP4 in private app storage, reject misleading media responses early, and preserve audio/language through bounded fallback.
- Select the requested HLS audio rendition, including non-English dubs, and reject ambiguous selections.
- Resolve WeebCentral, MangaKatana and MangaPill downloads directly on Android. Preserve compatible partial pages and existing queue records. MangaKakalot stays available for later upstream repair.
- Reduce reader decoding and rendering pressure, keep existing reading modes/progress, improve embedded-player cleanup and duplicate-control suppression, and use two simultaneous downloads on low-memory devices.
- Add optional local diagnostics with bounded, privacy-filtered history, Android process-exit metadata, manual export and clear controls. No automatic uploads.
- Preserve the established Th3-Anime reference interface, all fifteen provider entries and saved priorities, preferences, lists, histories, account data and package identity.

Version **0.1.43**, Android code **45**, newer than 0.1.42/code 44.
Package `com.brandon300.anivora`, ARM64, Android API 24 or newer; compatible
with Android 14. The release gate verifies the established signing certificate,
compiled source/bundle, native unit tests, Android14 download/storage/playback
integration and public APK delivery before advancing the update feed.

Remaining issues: several remote anime provider routes still return 404/500 or
intermittent results. Bounded live HTTP probes do not establish decoded playback
or spoken language. The specific WeebCentral termination on an Infinix Hot 50i
has not been reproduced on that physical device; emulator success does not
certify XOS memory/thermal behavior or real Cast hardware. Render is online;
existing account services are retained.

Install over the existing app. Do not uninstall or clear application data.

Source commit: https://github.com/brandon-300/Anivora/commit/fb6d9da473c3c466ed178a0ae2e7534cd715985f
